label: desktop-interactions
invocation: async (page) => { const checks={}; const button=page.locator(".critique button").first(); const tip=page.locator(".critique-popover").first(); const visible=()=>tip.evaluate(el=>getComputedStyle(el).visibility==="visible"&&getComputedStyle(el).opacity!=="0"); checks.pointerCritique=await visible(); await page.mouse.move(0,0); await button.focus(); await page.keyboard.press("Enter"); checks.critiqueEnter=await visible(); await page.keyboard.press("Space"); checks.critiqueSpace=await visible(); const accordion=page.locator(".ai-extension-accordion"), summary=accordion.locator("summary"); checks.aiInitiallyCollapsed=await accordion.evaluate(el=>!el.open); await summary.click(); checks.aiPointerOpened=await accordion.evaluate(el=>el.open); await page.keyboard.press("Enter"); checks.aiEnterClosed=await accordion.evaluate(el=>!el.open); await page.keyboard.press("Space"); checks.aiSpaceOpened=await accordion.evaluate(el=>el.open); await summary.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded(); if(Object.values(checks).some(v=>v!==true))throw new Error(JSON.stringify(checks)); return checks; }
